blocks.text: A letter to the judge, a report on a girl: in the podcast each is read aloud in the presence of someone who was never its addressee, and who cannot answer.
"These can be thought of as 'one-sided dialogues.'" — Amit
"A letter may be addressed to the judge, but to activate the dramatic situation, I instructed the readers to find the feeling that it was directed at the girl." — Ari
